cds.title: Texas A&M University-San Antonio Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Excel)

stats.notes: CDS C1 first-time, first-year totals (applied 8,936; admitted 8,442 = 3,603 men + 4,839 women; enrolled 1,293). The 2025-26 CDS does not report international applicants/admits, GPA, or SAT/ACT composite percentiles, so those are left empty; the cell for applied-by-sex printed as a spreadsheet error but the totals are given. Undergrad enrollment is B 'Total all undergraduates' (6,790); intl_undergrads is the CDS B nonresident count among degree-seeking undergraduates (27). Only 2 of the 1,293 first-year students were nonresidents. No waitlist, no early decision/early action.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8: scores are used in admission and advising (SAT, ACT, AP, CLEP, TSI listed); admissions site waives them for top 35% / 3.0 GPA applicants.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, year of the 2025-26 CDS): tuition 8,032 in-state and 18,878 out-of-state with required fees reported as 0 (i.e. fees appear to be included); on-campus food and housing 12,070; transportation 1,664 not included. No separate international tuition is printed. CDS H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 40 nonresidents received it (avg 13,713).
